control-plane · Delivered · PR open

What changes

  • Request review opens a picker in the reviews line instead of a “logins, comma-separated” field.
  • Before you type it lists GitHub’s suggested reviewers for this PR (the people who changed these files recently or commented), with their name and avatar from GitHub.
  • Typing searches everyone who can review in the repository (GitHub’s assignable users) by login or name, plus teams when the repo is in an organisation.
  • Pick several. They go into a list above the field, each with a remove button. Then Ask 2 people. People already requested are shown but can’t be picked. The PR author never appears.
  • Keyboard: ↑↓ move · Enter picks · ⌫ on an empty field drops the last one · ⌘/Ctrl+Enter asks · Esc closes the list, then the picker.

CI unavailable, said plainly

  • Today the chip says “CI unavailable” and the reason is a single sentence about token permissions. Proposed: the checks line names what is missing (Checks: Read) and links to the GitHub settings page where an admin fixes it.

Design system

  • SearchPicker grows three opt-in props: findOnEmpty (call find("") when focused: suggestions), group(option) (headed sections in the listbox), and optionDisabled(option) with a reason. Multi-pick stays in the app: onPick adds to a RemovableList and the picker clears its words (clearOnPick).
  • New GitHubUserLine (EntityLine size sm): avatar, name in strong ink, mono login and why it’s suggested beneath. It is used for a team too, with a square face.
  • README rule: “ask for a GitHub login with a SearchPicker of who can review, never a text field of logins.” The same applies to Settings → GitHub → “These people”.
